description: Weighted 0-100 idea scoring rubric for The Invisible Why. The Idea Scorer agent fills in the 0-10 sub-scores; score_idea.js computes the weighted total deterministically so scoring stays auditable and reproducible.

factors.label: Curiosity / click potential
factors.description: Does the one-line hook alone create a need-to-know gap?

factors.label: Expected retention
factors.description: Does the topic naturally escalate (mechanism -> twist -> deeper cause) across 9-14 minutes?

factors.label: Demand / trend
factors.description: Is there a real search/competitor/discussion signal, or is this purely an editorial hunch?

factors.label: Evergreen potential
factors.description: Will this still be true and searched-for in 5 years?

factors.label: Ad / sponsor friendliness
factors.description: Does this fit finance, productivity, health, or learning sponsor categories and YouTube's advertiser-friendly guidelines?

factors.label: Visual explainability
factors.description: Is there a clear system, process, or before/after that a hand-drawn explainer can actually show?

factors.label: Competitive differentiation
factors.description: Is this under-covered, or does our angle meaningfully differ from existing coverage?
